title: Using Claude to create VFX for Godot
author: Equivalent-Future439
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1upakvn/video/iw4cvbjpeobh1/player

Still working on the skill itself, but this is my first water blob test. I'm kind of impressed to be honest. Anyone have similar workflows or tips for having claude/codex assist with VFX creation?

comments.author: CashFirm573
comments.body: I've been trying to push them to different levels, I found very careful planning and support images and explaining in detail about what processes to use what not. Getting rather good results but still could use some work.

replies.author: Equivalent-Future439
replies.body: I feel you. I've built a stringent skill that references official Godot docs, any free tutorials and techniques online, and I'm using Genshin/Wuthering Waves, those kinds of anime games for styling reference. I'm using an extensive VFX library (free stuff on itch and other places) and some paid VFX that I have the AI also reference in terms of structure and stuff like that. It's been pretty impressive so far to be honest
